zones: all zones in which a continuous effect applies
objects: objects, players, and game rules affected by continuous effects
events: continuous reevaluation after every relevant state change
state_reads: serialized zone and World-since timestamp moments
state_writes: derived characteristics only; authoritative object timestamps are maintained by the zone and supertype boundary
costs: cost-changing effects are delegated to the casting and activation cost pipeline
choices: simultaneous timestamp choices require APNAP collection
hidden_information: derived public characteristics must not reveal hidden copiable values
replacement_effects: as-enters copy and face-up/down choices may feed copiable values
copy: copy effects apply in layer 1a before later characteristic changes
zone_change: new objects and zone changes create or reset timestamps
source_leaves: duration and locked-in affected-object sets determine continued application

known_blockers: not every existing ad hoc static ability has been converted to a declarative effect
dependency discovery is supplied by the compiler rather than inferred from arbitrary effect programs
serialized zone timestamp moments are not yet consumed by every continuous-effect source
player/game-rule effects and APNAP relative-timestamp decisions are not integrated
full face-down, merged permanent, and sticker copiable values are not integrated
